dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observation of three distinct closed 'O' shapes and two fragmented 'C' shapes on the lateral surface. The most prominent structures exhibit a high-contrast transition from dark exterior pixels to a thin, light-toned perimeter that encloses a darker, mottled interior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels are concentrated along the upper dorsal curvature, appearing as solid, asymmetrical white patches that lack internal gradient or structural resolution.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the upper lateral flank form a scalene triangle; the relative distance between the two posterior-most centroids is significantly greater than the distance between the superior and inferior-lateral centroids.
